sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the connection between the passing of Rashbi and the Omer counting, emphasizing that the work of refining the animal soul draws down a great abundance to the lowest levels.

translations.translation: And based on all the above, the connection of the passing of Rashbi with the counting of the Omer will also be understood,
to the extent that the day of his passing is called
(based on the custom of Israel, Torah it is92)
by the name Lag BaOmer93.
And the explanation is,
that the service of the counting of the Omer is the refinement of the midos of the Nefesh HaBahamis94,
and nevertheless
(and moreover,
because of this),
specifically regarding this mitzvah we say95
"and through this a great abundance will be drawn forth in all the worlds,"
for specifically the work of refinement reaches to the very highest level,
and draws down from there an abundance,
not a light that is merely an illumination, but an abundance that is the essence of the thing96,
and beyond this—a great abundance,
and because it is a great abundance, therefore97
(due to the multiplicity within it)
it is drawn and flows into all the worlds,
down to this lowest world,
and within this world itself, to the most lowly place, beneath which there is no lower.
And it can be said that this is the connection of the days of the counting
[and within them specifically,
the day of Lag BaOmer,
the end and completion of the service of the Omer counting in the primary midos98]
to the passing of Rashbi,
for the service of Rashbi was to heal and nullify the partitions between all matters,
and to draw down from the highest high to the lowest low,
from the aspect of "Eisan" to the aspect of "Eretz."
And this matter stands revealed on the day of his passing, on Lag BaOmer,
as explained in Igeres HaKodesh of the Alter Rebbe99
that on the day of passing, all of a person's service which he served throughout the days of his life stands revealed as it is in its source and root,
and as explained at length in the discourses of Lag BaOmer in the Siddur of the Mitteler Rebbe100.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section describes how this matter extends down to simple joy, breaking the boundaries of exile and bringing the true redemption through Moshiach, connected to the spreading of the wellsprings.

translations.translation: And this matter extends downward to the lowest level, to simple joy101.
And to the extent that from this is drawn a very great joy,
to a joy that breaks boundaries102,
eternal joy103,
which breaks the boundaries of exile,
and brings the true and complete redemption through Moshiach Tzidkeinu,
for Moshiach comes to bring the righteous back in repentance55.
And this is also connected with the matter of the spreading of the wellsprings,
"When will the Master come? When your wellsprings spread forth outward"104,
speedily in our days, literally,
and in our time, quickly105.
